correctness.rationale: The proof derives the exact maximum by splitting singleton versus no-singleton supports; pairs eliminate exactly their complementary triples and feasible pair families are stars or triangles. Positive weights force all compatible co-atoms and triples, while the coordinatewise gain monotonicity reduces to seven sorted cases. The independently enumerated 30-class support graph has 81 maximal cliques; all 39 tested field-size tuples match both formulas. Direct ring adjacency tests in four prime-field examples confirm the source-support model. This is a full symbolic proof, not extrapolation from computation.
